intent: Fill M4 depth targets from the reservoirs. ZN (rested from N) supplies the recurrent tiers; the W bench supplies deep recurrent and Discovery. Split is by artist familiarity, which is the real distinction between a recurrent and a discovery track, since neither pool carries any play history to score against. One track per artist, round-robin, so the set is diverse rather than alphabetically clustered. A1, A2, N and H2 are deliberately NOT filled here — they need current adds and pre-1980 material the reservoirs do not contain.
